import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'submission');import gateway
base=['MESSAGE sip:d@d.test SIP/2.0','From: <sip:a@b>','To: <sip:c@d>','Call-ID: x','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE','Content-Length: 0']
def status(extra,body=''):
 t='\r\n'.join(base[:1]+[x for x in base[1:-1]]+extra+[base[-1]])+'\r\n\r\n'+body
 try:gateway._parse_request(t);return True,len(t)
 except gateway.SIPFailure:return False,len(t)
for n in [126,127,128,129]:
 ok,l=status(['X: a']*n)
 print('logical extra',n,'fields total',n+5,'ok',ok,'len',l)
for n in [510,511,512,513]:
 # use continuations after one X: continuation lines; total physical field lines n
 # one new field then n-1 blank-continuations
 extra=['X: a']+[' b']*(n-1)
 ok,l=status(extra)
 print('physical field lines',n,'ok',ok,'len',l)
PY
